text: 你穿过埃斯伯里的街道，不时走近一栋房子，核对门牌与要找的地址，以确认自己的位置。
过了一会儿，你抵达约书亚家。你把钥匙插进锁里，开门走进一处小起居空间。
环顾四周，你看见紧凑的客厅和厨房。公共区域两端各有一扇门。左边的门敞开着，可以看见一段通往楼下的楼梯。右边的门关着，你猜那是卧室。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 151
text: You make your way through Esbury’s streets, confirming your whereabouts every so often by approaching a building to check the address against the location you’re searching for.
After some time, you arrive at Joshua’s house. You insert the key in the lock and open the door into a small living area.

Glancing around, you see a compact living room and kitchen. There are two doors at opposite ends of the common area. The door to your left is wide open and you can see a set of stairs leading down. The door to your right is closed. You assume it leads to the bedroom.
